think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s data type and allowed values. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob with an inherent ordering. 3) If numeric, determine whether it has sentinel/special numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/override), breaking the normal numeric ordering. 4) If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
